Actress Niti Taylor Recounts Casting Couch Incident

Actress Niti Taylor has revealed a past experience with a Telugu film director who allegedly demanded sexual favors in exchange for a role. Taylor stated that this incident caused her to quit films and that she did not disclose it to anyone at the time. The director's alleged demand was for a casting couch experience.
